guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：5G 網路切片
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: 5G network slicing
guides.concept: 以切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「切片識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「接取與核心」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端到端切片需要協調無線、傳輸與核心資源。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「網路功能共用」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Admission control」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：新增需求要通過可用資源及服務限制審查。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較共用與分離 UPF 的故障域。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「QoS 映射」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「隔離層次」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：邏輯權限、資源排程與物理隔離提供不同保證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資源，只改 admission 需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「生命週期」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「策略授權」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：管理切片的權限不應等於存取其資料權限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「故障域」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解配置證據」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「服務合約」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat slice identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around access and core, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: End-to-end slicing coordinates radio, transport and core resources. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat shared network functions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around admission control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: New demand needs available-resource and service-bound checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare shared and separated UPF failure domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qos mapping as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around isolation layers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Logical permissions, scheduling and physical separation provide different guarantees. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep resources fixed and change admission demand. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat lifecycle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around policy authorization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Slice-management permissions should differ from data-access permissions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat failure domains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around deprovisioning evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service contracts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「SLA 尾端」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「解配置證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「解配置證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for sla tails. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for deprovisioning evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for deprovisioning evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
pitfalls: 同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

sources.scope: 資源導向存取決策、身分與設備的驗證；只在自有隔離模型中練習。
sources.scopeEn: Resource-oriented access decisions and identity/device verification, practiced only in owned isolated models.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 行動核心網路
related.why: 可移植「服務合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from service contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「服務合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from service contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據；「行動核心網路」主要處理5G 核心服務、控制／用戶平面與狀態，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence; Mobile core networks emphasizes 5g core services, control/user planes and state. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「5G 網路切片」與「行動核心網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「網路功能共用」的對照方法至「服務式介面」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw 5G network slicing and Mobile core networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from shared network functions to service-based interfaces, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence; Enterprise zero-trust networks emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「5G 網路切片」與「企業零信任網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「網路功能共用」的對照方法至「裝置證據」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw 5G network slicing and Enterprise zero-trust networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from shared network functions to device evidence, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
